import html # Example template; replace with the actual one used in your application. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{headline}

By: {poster_name}

{text}
{tags}
""" def compose_post_html(poster_name: str, headline: str, text: str, hashtags: list[str]) -> str: """ Build an XSS‑safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- poster_name : str The name of the user who posted. headline : str The title of the post. text : str The main body content of the post. hashtags : list[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str An HTML string containing the escaped post data and tags. """ # Escape all user‑supplied content to neutralise HTML/JS injection escaped_poster = html.escape(poster_name, quote=True) escaped_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) escaped_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Build tags: each tag is wrapped in and escaped escaped_tags = [] for tag in hashtags: # Ensure the tag is a string and strip surrounding whitespace if not isinstance(tag, str): raise TypeError(f"Tag must be a string, got {type(tag).__name__}") clean_tag = tag.strip() escaped_tag = html.escape(clean_tag, quote=True) escaped_tags.append(f'{escaped_tag}') tags_html = ' '.join(escaped_tags) # Format the final HTML using the provided template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster_name=escaped_poster, headline=escaped_headline, text=escaped_text, tags=tags_html )
